---
title: "Todesfälle"
format: html
editor: source
---


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(scales)
  library(fs)
  library(here)
  library(lubridate)
  library(plotly)
})
```

```{r}
load(path("r_data","pop_death_aut_bl_complete.RData"))
```
```{r}
theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

```{r}
pop_death_aut_bl_complete |>
  select(Jahr,Datum,Woche,BundeslandID,Anzahl) |>
  filter(Jahr>=2010, Woche %in% 23:36,
         BundeslandID==9) |>
  group_by(Woche,Datum,Jahr) |>
  summarise(Tote=sum(Anzahl)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Datum_2026 = `year<-`(Datum,2026)) ->
  chart_data
chart_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Datum_2026,y=Tote,group=Jahr,
             color=factor(Jahr),
             data_id=Jahr,
             text=Jahr)) +
  geom_line(size=0.1) +
  geom_line(data=chart_data |>
              filter(Jahr==2026),
            aes(x=Datum_2026,y=Tote),
            color="firebrick") +
  scale_color_manual(values=rep("black", n_distinct(chart_data$Jahr)), guide="none") +
  scale_y_continuous("Todesfälle",
                     breaks=seq(0,500,by=50),
                     limits=c(0,NA)) +
  labs(title="Wöchentliche Todesfälle in Wien ab Anfang Juni seit 2010",
       x="Datum") ->
  p
gp <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(hoverlabel = list(bgcolor="white", bordercolor="black", font=list(color="black"))) |>
  onRender("
function(el, x) {
  var gd = document.getElementById(el.id);
  var hoverWidth = 4;
  // Remember each trace's own original width so we restore the
  // correct value (not a single hardcoded default) on unhover.
  var originalWidths = gd.data.map(function(tr) {
    return (tr.line && tr.line.width) ? tr.line.width : 1;
  });
  var lastCurve = null;

  gd.on('plotly_hover', function(d) {
    var curve = d.points[0].curveNumber;
    if (curve === lastCurve) return;

    if (lastCurve !== null) {
      Plotly.restyle(gd, {'line.width': originalWidths[lastCurve]}, [lastCurve]);
    }

    Plotly.restyle(gd, {'line.width': hoverWidth}, [curve]);
    lastCurve = curve;
  });

  gd.on('plotly_unhover', function(d) {
    if (lastCurve !== null) {
      Plotly.restyle(gd, {'line.width': originalWidths[lastCurve]}, [lastCurve]);
      lastCurve = null;
    }
  });
}
")
gp
```
